subject: Night soak credit request — trial/promo coverage
messages:
From: Derek Shaw <derek.shaw@acme-ai.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: extra trial credits for night soak (throughput + p99 focus)

Hi Stephanie,

Hope you’re well — we’re ramping a POC soak run next weekend and want to validate p95/p99 under sustained 1k RPS. The plan is an overnight soak (target window below) to exercise KV cache behavior and real user prefixes.

Planned window: 2026-09-18 23:00 PDT through 2026-09-19 07:00 PDT (8 hours)
Estimated burn: ~320k tokens total (mix of generation + embeddings for diagnostics)
Primary ask: Can Redwood provision promo trial credits (or a temporary token voucher) to cover an additional ~200k tokens and extend our trial window by 7 days to avoid hitting quota mid-test?

We’ve attached the load-plan.xlsx with traffic shape and token burn estimates. Also, we’d like a brief canary route (single endpoint) with monitoring hooks to stream latency metrics to our telemetry feed. If you need a signed MA plan we can do that quickly.

Main success criteria: stable p95 < 250ms, p99 < 800ms for generation endpoints for the duration of the soak. If we see regressions we’ll collect evals and share immediately.

Thanks — Derek
Derek Shaw
Head of Platform Engineering | Acme AI
ops@acme-ai.com

Attachment: load-plan.xlsx (spreadsheet, ~12KB)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Derek Shaw <derek.shaw@acme-ai.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: extra trial credits for night soak (throughput + p99 focus)

Hi Derek — thanks for the details and the plan attachment. This is the sort of soak we expect and happy to help. A few quick questions before I loop in ops/finance for promo approval:

- Confirmed burn estimate: you mentioned ~320k tokens and asking for an additional ~200k. Can you break that down by endpoint type (generation vs embeddings) and give us a peak token/s estimate?
- Do you need a dedicated endpoint (reserved) or is the hosted route sufficient?
- Are you able to share a read-only Grafana or telemetry webhook so our SREs can watch the same metrics during the run?

Next steps: I’ll share the draft MA plan we use for short-term promos (attached ma_plan_template.docx) and loop Ben for approval. If you can reply with the breakdown above and confirm the start/end times we’ll fast-track a provisional voucher.

If approved we can:
- Apply a promo voucher to your org for the tokens approved
- Add an 7-day trial extension window in case the run spills over
- Stand up a canary route and give you a link to stream latency traces to Redwood’s console

I’ll hold until Ben confirms.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference

Attachment: ma_plan_template.docx (template)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, Derek Shaw <derek.shaw@acme-ai.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Night soak credit request — provisional approval

Looping in from finance/sales ops — provisional OK from my side. Conditions and details below:

- Promo voucher: NIGHTSOAK150K (150,000 token credit) to be applied to Acme AI org on 2026-09-18 at 22:45 PDT.
- Trial extension: 48 hours added to org trial window (to cover small spillover).
- Approval is conditional on receiving the signed MA plan (I’ll need a signed PDF before we apply the full voucher if your burn exceeds 150k).
- If the run exceeds the voucher we’ll work with you on a one-off additional top-up; we’ll prioritize technical support but any extra token spend beyond promo will be billed at our standard trial overage rates.

Stephanie — please provision the voucher as provisional and hold off full application until the signed MA plan is uploaded to the deal.

Marissa — FYI in case we need to escalate or convert to a reserved capacity follow-up.

Ben Carter
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

(Internal note: approved up to 150k promo, require signed MA plan if >150k.)

From: Derek Shaw <derek.shaw@acme-ai.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Night soak credit request — confirmation and MA plan

Thanks Ben/Stephanie — appreciate the quick turnaround. Confirming we accept the conditional path. A few clarifications:

- Breakdown: generation endpoints ~260k tokens, embeddings for diagnostics ~60k tokens (total ~320k). Peak token/s ~45k tokens/minute during bursts (short spikes).
- Hosted route is fine; we don’t require Dedicated for this run.
- Start/end confirmed: 2026-09-18 23:00 PDT → 2026-09-19 07:00 PDT. We’ll start a warm-up at 22:30 PDT.
- We’ll sign the MA plan and upload a signed PDF by EOD next Tuesday.
- Telemetry: will share a read-only Grafana link and invite redwood-ops Slack channel (we’ll add redwood-support). If p99 > 800ms we’ll open an escalation ticket with your on-call.

I’ve re-attached the final load-plan and added token burn per endpoint inside the spreadsheet. We’ll plan to consume the 150k voucher first; if we hit it we’ll pause non-critical jobs and let you know.

Thanks — Derek

Attachment: load-plan.xlsx (updated with per-endpoint breakdown)
Slack: #acme-redwood-ops
Telemetry: https://grafana.acme-ai.com/d/soak/overnight

I’ve provisioned the provisional voucher NIGHTSOAK150K on your org and added the 48-hour trial extension (you should see the flag in the console link below). Safe soak — ping me in Slack if anything spikes.
